meta.title: Working with Call Transcripts in ScoutOS
meta.description: Learn to create an agent that fetches and summarizes call transcripts, then automate it with workflows and webhooks
meta.author: Scout Team

checkpoint.label: I understand what we're building in this course
checkpoint.hint: We'll create an agent, connect it to a workflow, and trigger it via webhook

checkpoint.label: I've created the Call Transcript Summarizer agent
checkpoint.hint: Scout should confirm the agent was created and provide an ID

checkpoint.label: I've added code execution tools and saved my agent
checkpoint.hint: Make sure to select 'Execute TypeScript' from the tools menu

checkpoint.label: My agent successfully fetched and summarized a transcript
checkpoint.hint: Paste a transcript ID and verify you get a summary back

checkpoint.label: I've created and published my workflow
checkpoint.hint: Your workflow should have an Input trigger connected to your agent

checkpoint.label: I've created a webhook and copied the URL
checkpoint.hint: Click 'Add Webhook' in the workflow panel

checkpoint.label: I've completed the end-to-end test successfully
checkpoint.hint: Generate a new transcript and watch it flow through your workflow
